create_TensorboardWriter: create a TensorboardWriter instance from a SlowFast config to log training metrics to Tensorboard
add_scalars: add multiple scalar values from a dictionary to Tensorboard logs with an optional global step
plot_eval: plot confusion matrices and histograms for model predictions versus true labels during evaluation
add_confusion_matrix: calculate and plot a confusion matrix to a Tensorboard SummaryWriter with optional class name labels
add_ndim_array: visualize n-dimensional tensors as a 2D grid image with optional heatmap in Tensorboard
